title: Technician Time Punch
description: The actual clock-in/clock-out record for a technician working a specific job, as opposed to the flat-rate hours billed for that job.
x-sap-analogue: Time confirmation (CATS-style) feeding an activity allocation
x-api-note: technicianPunchTimes is a documented nested array inside Get Repair Order v3; there's no standalone real-time punch-clock API found separate from the RO payload.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.
